tabs.html:
Jilong 280T All-Rounder Middle Trunk Line Fusion Splicer 

High-Performance Fiber Splicing for Trunk Line Networks

The Jilong 280T All-Rounder Middle Trunk Line Fusion Splicer is a professional-grade fiber splicing machine, designed for high-capacity backbone fiber optic networks. Built with core alignment technology, it ensures minimal splice loss, fast operation, and reliable performance in all environments.

Key Features of Jilong 280T Fusion Splicer

  • Core Alignment Technology – Achieves ultra-precise fiber alignment for low splice loss
  • High-Speed Splicing & Heating – 8 sec. quick splicing & 18 sec. fast heating for maximum efficiency
  • User-Friendly 4.3-inch Touchscreen – Capacitive display for easy operation
  • Dual Camera System (320X Magnification) – Provides clear fiber visualization for accurate splicing
  • Smart Automatic Functions – Auto arc calibration, fiber identification & splice loss estimation
  • Powerful 6800mAh Battery – Supports 300+ splice & heat cycles per charge
  • Durable & Compact Design – Lightweight (1.9kg), rugged construction for field use
  • Large Data Storage – Saves 10,000 splice records & 2,000 result images
  • Wide Compatibility – Supports SM, MM, DS, NZDS, and G.657 fiber types


Jilong 280T Technical Specifications

  • Alignment Method: Core Alignment
  • Applicable Fiber Types: SM (G.652/G.657), MM (G.651), DS (G.653), NZDS (G.655)
  • Compatible Fiber/Cable: 0.25~3.0mm, Rubber-Insulated Fiber Cable
  • Fiber Cleave Length: 8-16mm
  • Splicing Time: 8 sec. (Quick Mode), 15 sec. (Standard Mode)
  • Heating Time: 18 sec. (Adjustable)
  • Splice Loss: SM: 0.02dB, MM: 0.01dB, DS: 0.04dB, NZDS: 0.04dB
  • Return Loss: >60dB
  • Electrode Life: 5,000 arcs (extendable with grinder)
  • Battery: 6800mAh, supports 300+ splicing & heating cycles per charge
  • Storage Capacity: 10,000 splice records, 2,000 images
  • Tension Test: 1.96~2.25N
  • Operating Conditions: -20°C to +50°C, 0-95% humidity, 0-5000m altitude
  • Weight: 1.6kg (without battery), 1.9kg (with battery)
  • Display: 4.3-inch capacitive touchscreen
  • USB 2.0 Port – For firmware updates & data transfer


Why Choose the Jilong 280T Fusion Splicer?

  • Perfect for Middle Trunk Line & Backbone Fiber Networks
  • Fastest Splicing & Heating Time – Maximizes Work Efficiency
  • Reliable & Rugged – Ideal for Harsh Environments
  • Large Battery Capacity – Suitable for Field Technicians
  • Best Price in Bangladesh (2025) – Great Value for Money
